text:
Eve (Design): Dropped an 'Audit overlay' mock for the Alerting rule editor. Idea: a lightweight timeline you can open that shows who changed thresholds, which suppression rules were active at the time, and a quick diff between the selected config and live. Figma: https://figma.redwood/audit-overlay

Boris (PM): Love this for postmortems. One ask: make the overlay linkable so engineers can paste a snapshot in runbooks. Also: mask user emails in public links.

Laila (Frontend): Linkable snapshots ok — we'll return a short id (e.g., s-abc123) and render a share modal. Implementation note: fetch the snapshot JSON on open. For diffs, using a compact '+'/'-' inline summary helps scan.

Oscar (Accessibility): Key a11y points: (1) the overlay must be reachable by keyboard without skipping the main form; (2) when opened, focus should move into it and be trapped; (3) announce the snapshot timestamp via an aria-live polite region.

Ruth (SRE): Also include the provenance of suppressions: not just "quiet window" but whether it was inherited from team-level or applied by a recent rollback. That helped us debug last outage. Show the rule id and lastEval time.

Eve (Design): Good — mock shows: header with snapshot time + owner; compact diff list (thresholds changed, channel reorder changes, suppression toggles) and a small footer 'Share snapshot' button. Copy question: use 'snapshot' or 'config view'? Which is clearer?

Boris (PM): 'Snapshot' communicates immutability which is good. Use 'share snapshot' in the UI and 'preview' when it's ephemeral/local. Also add a short warning when sharing a snapshot that contains sensitive names.

Laila (Frontend): We'll add a `masked` flag in the snapshot API and strip names client-side when necessary. Example API: {"snapshotId":"s-abc123","masked":true}. Also add a read-only view param: `?view=snapshot` so the render path is simple.

Oscar (Accessibility): Visual contrast: the diff additions are green in the mock but low contrast in dark mode. Use tokenized colors with WCAG-compliant values. Also each diff row should have `aria-describedby` pointing to the human-readable reason so SR users get context.

Ruth (SRE): Small feature ask: allow running a simulated eval against a snapshot so we can see if that historical config would have notified differently. That lets us validate regressions. It could be heavy but opt-in.

Eve (Design): Nice! UI idea: a small play icon 'Run snapshot simulation' that triggers the same notify-sim we discussed earlier. Results would be appended to the overlay as a short table.

Boris (PM): Product note: gate the simulation runs behind an internal quota. And log who ran sims for audit trails.

share-bot: snapshot s-abc123 created by @Boris at 2025-01-09T14:12:34Z (masked: true)

Laila (Frontend): I'll prototype the overlay with focus trap and the share flow. Will post a tiny PR and include tests for keyboard navigation and masked snapshots.

Oscar (Accessibility): I'll review the PR and run a quick NVDA/VoiceOver pass on the overlay. Focus + live announcements are the key items.

Ruth (SRE): I'll add a short blurb to the runbook templates describing how to use snapshot links for postmortem timelines. Also will request that snapshots auto-expire after 30 days unless promoted.

Eve (Design): Thanks all — I'll update mocks to show the simulation results section and the share warning modal. Aim to land behind a feature flag next sprint. :thumbsup:
